title: かたつむり (Katatumuri — Snail)
description: A playful 1911 elementary school song asking a snail: 'Where is your head? Where are your eyes?' — prompting it to extend its tentacles. The song connects to a classic kyogen (traditional comedy) play about a snail, and has been used in Japanese schools for over a century. Very simple vocabulary and a catchy, repetitive structure make it perfect for beginners learning body part vocabulary.
